counting_rule: one distinct decision method with applicability, procedure, failure, evidence, target, and public source binding

knowledge.claim: Explore problems and alternatives broadly before converging on a defined brief and validated delivery.
knowledge.applicability: Design tasks with uncertain framing or multiple plausible solutions.
knowledge.failure: The first plausible result is accepted without discovery or alternative comparison.
knowledge.rights_note: The framework page states CC BY 4.0; verify exact reused assets separately.

knowledge.claim: Ground decisions in users, tasks, environments, and iterative evaluation throughout the lifecycle.
knowledge.applicability: Interactive products, services, controls, displays, and web experiences.
knowledge.failure: Aesthetic preference substitutes for observed context and measured usability.
knowledge.rights_note: The full standard is licensed and must not be copied without rights.

knowledge.claim: Size, contrast, spacing, alignment, and typography must express priority and reading order rather than decorate.
knowledge.applicability: Interfaces, advertisements, reports, packaging, signage, and publications.
knowledge.failure: Every element competes equally or color alone carries meaning.
knowledge.rights_note: Retain attribution and verify page terms before redistribution.

knowledge.claim: Physical-product design must jointly resolve appearance, functionality, manufacturability, and lasting user value.
knowledge.applicability: Mass-produced devices, appliances, tools, furniture, packaging, and controls.
procedure: Validate safety, manufacture, maintenance, and end-of-life
knowledge.failure: A concept render is accepted despite unsafe ergonomics or no manufacturing route.
knowledge.rights_note: Do not reproduce protected imagery or extended source text.

knowledge.claim: Physical controls, displays, sound, haptics, and companion interfaces must share one consistent state machine.
knowledge.applicability: Appliances, vehicles, kiosks, wearables, instruments, and connected products.
knowledge.failure: The display contradicts the physical control or provides no recoverable feedback.
knowledge.rights_note: Derived candidate requiring expert validation and licensed-standard review.

knowledge.claim: Web design must preserve perceivability, operability, understandability, and robustness as testable requirements.
knowledge.applicability: Web pages, applications, interactive documents, and embedded web views.
procedure: Meet contrast, target-size, input, and reflow rules
knowledge.failure: A polished page is promoted while keyboard, reflow, focus, alternatives, or target size fails.
knowledge.rights_note: Preserve the standard version and exact criterion locator.

knowledge.claim: Objective advertising claims and comparisons require documentary evidence and visible, understandable qualifications.
knowledge.applicability: Display, print, video, social, landing-page, environmental, and comparative advertising.
knowledge.failure: Headline, imagery, or disclaimer creates a stronger promise than evidence supports.
knowledge.rights_note: Market-specific legal review remains required.

knowledge.claim: Publication layout must preserve headings, reading order, alternatives, table structure, language, metadata, and reflow.
knowledge.applicability: Reports, books, manuals, brochures, PDF, EPUB, and digital publications.
procedure: Test tags, alternatives, zoom, and reflow
knowledge.failure: The page looks correct but is flattened or has broken reading order and tables.
knowledge.rights_note: Evaluate each technique against target format and WCAG version.

knowledge.claim: Typography must be tested for audience, medium, distance, language, line length, spacing, and reading duration.
knowledge.applicability: Long-form print and digital publications, manuals, reports, and captions.
knowledge.failure: A fashionable treatment reduces legibility, loses characters, or breaks on export.
knowledge.rights_note: Print-specific claims require separate evidence.

knowledge.claim: Generative design should create an editable foundation, preserve human control, and support repeated refinement.
knowledge.applicability: Prompt-to-layout, prompt-to-prototype, prompt-to-code, and AI asset generation.
procedure: Expose layers, components, code, and tokens
knowledge.failure: The result is a flattened image or opaque code that cannot be safely refined.
knowledge.rights_note: Vendor philosophy is descriptive, not independent proof of quality.

knowledge.claim: Learn general design patterns and tool structure without retaining or reproducing customer-specific content, concepts, or sensitive data.
knowledge.applicability: Training, fine-tuning, retrieval, telemetry, and prompt-to-design services.
knowledge.failure: Customer designs or ideas are reproduced across tenants or reused beyond declared purposes.
knowledge.rights_note: Vendor statements require independent technical verification.

knowledge.claim: Generated assets require source-rights controls, prompt and output safeguards, and provenance transparency before commercial use.
knowledge.applicability: Image, illustration, texture, advertising, packaging, brand, and publication generation.
knowledge.failure: A suitable-looking asset is treated as commercially safe without rights or similarity checks.
knowledge.source_locator: Approach to generative AI with Adobe Firefly
knowledge.rights_note: Vendor claims do not replace project-specific rights review.

knowledge.claim: An agent-ready design system needs predictable foundations, composable components, proven patterns, machine-readable tokens, and accessible implementation guidance.
knowledge.applicability: AI-assisted UI generation that must remain consistent, brandable, accessible, and maintainable.
procedure: Preserve component internals and override points
knowledge.failure: The agent copies surface styling without component semantics, interaction contracts, or accessible behavior.
knowledge.source_locator: Astryx summary: foundations, components, patterns and agent-facing CLI/MCP
knowledge.rights_note: Secondary summary only; bind the primary Astryx documentation and MIT license before activation.

knowledge.claim: When generation becomes cheap, design quality shifts to problem framing, value selection, constraints, and evidence of usefulness rather than output volume.
knowledge.applicability: AI-generated products, interfaces, campaigns, and content where many plausible artifacts can be produced quickly.
procedure: Define the user and business problem
knowledge.failure: Fast artifact generation is mistaken for solving a worthwhile problem.
knowledge.source_locator: AI가 다 만드는데, 왜 자꾸 기획을 말할까?
knowledge.rights_note: Discovery-level candidate; full article bytes and author argument must be reviewed before promotion.

knowledge.claim: Above-average design depends on explicit comparative judgment: recognizing generic output, explaining why one alternative fits better, and recording the selection criteria.
knowledge.applicability: LLM-generated visual, product, web, advertising, and publication alternatives.
procedure: Generate more than one viable option
Validate with target users and experts
knowledge.failure: The first polished-looking output is accepted because no decision criteria or comparative review exists.
knowledge.rights_note: Treat as a practitioner hypothesis until full text and independent evidence are reviewed.

knowledge.claim: Before inventing a new UI solution, retrieve applicable system components and established interaction patterns, then generate only the unresolved portion.
knowledge.applicability: Design-system-backed UI creation, redesign, and partial regeneration.
procedure: Generate and label only the gap
knowledge.failure: The model hallucinates a novel component while an approved accessible component or pattern already exists.
knowledge.source_locator: AI에게 디자인을 지어내지 말고 찾아 쓰라
knowledge.rights_note: Do not copy a referenced design merely because it was retrieved; rights and project fitness remain separate gates.

knowledge.claim: AI may adapt an interface, but stable user expectations, safety-critical conventions, accessibility semantics, and recovery patterns remain constraints rather than expendable templates.
knowledge.applicability: Adaptive, conversational, generative, and personalized interfaces.
knowledge.failure: Personalization changes controls or navigation so aggressively that users cannot predict, recover, or transfer learning.
knowledge.rights_note: The source raises a design question; the operational claim requires full-text and empirical validation.

knowledge.claim: Code, motion, 3D, shaders, components, and runtime behavior are design materials whose intent and parameters must remain connected from exploration through implementation.
knowledge.applicability: Interactive prototypes and products combining UI, animation, spatial effects, code, and production assets.
procedure: Compare implementation against the design contract
knowledge.failure: A canvas mockup is approved while motion, state, performance, or generated code diverges during implementation.
knowledge.rights_note: Product-report claims must be checked against Figma primary documentation and actual runtime behavior.

knowledge.claim: AI design orchestration should separate model choice from artifact contracts, keep credentials and project history local where required, and export inspectable editable formats.
knowledge.applicability: Confidential or regulated design work using multiple cloud or local models.
procedure: Select an allowed provider or local model
Generate through a stable artifact schema
Sandbox preview and verify each export
knowledge.failure: Switching models changes the artifact contract, leaks protected data, or produces unverified flattened exports.
knowledge.source_locator: Open CoDesign local-first, multi-provider, artifact and exporter architecture
knowledge.rights_note: Verify security, privacy, format fidelity, and license claims against the project repository and releases.

knowledge.claim: AI-assisted commerce redesign must preserve product truth, information hierarchy, reusable structure, and measurable purchase-task performance rather than optimize visual novelty alone.
knowledge.applicability: Product-detail pages, commerce landing pages, catalog content, and AI-assisted redesign.
procedure: A/B test comprehension and purchase-task outcomes
knowledge.failure: AI-generated imagery or copy improves appearance while distorting the product, hiding conditions, or weakening decision-critical information.
knowledge.rights_note: Case-study discovery only; do not infer outcomes or reuse assets without full source and project rights.

knowledge.claim: Field research must bind the problem context, research questions, participant criteria, method, tasks, ethics, records, and planned synthesis before observation begins.
knowledge.applicability: Products and services whose real context, workarounds, environment, or user behavior is not adequately known.
procedure: State the problem context and hypotheses
Record consent, observations, and synthesis plan
knowledge.failure: Unstructured conversations are treated as representative user evidence without recruitment, context, consent, or traceable notes.
knowledge.rights_note: Validate the method against primary research ethics and UX research references before activation.

knowledge.claim: A journey map is evidence-bound only when its actor, goal, lifecycle scope, touchpoints, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities trace to research.
knowledge.applicability: Multi-step services and cross-channel experiences involving several touchpoints, owners, or handoffs.
procedure: Define the goal and journey boundary
Attach evidence for pain and emotion
knowledge.failure: A fictional journey generated from assumptions is presented as user research.
knowledge.rights_note: Templates and illustrations may have separate rights; retain only the method candidate.

knowledge.claim: Prototype fidelity must match the question being tested, and usability evidence must come from representative users performing defined tasks.
knowledge.applicability: Flows, controls, navigation, information architecture, and interaction concepts before production release.
knowledge.failure: Stakeholder preference or a self-review of a polished prototype is labeled as usability validation.
knowledge.source_locator: 1-3 HCI와 UX 적용 기술—사용성 테스트와 프로토타이핑
knowledge.rights_note: Introductory secondary material; triangulate with a primary usability-testing standard.

knowledge.claim: Accessibility validation requires criterion-based automated checks plus keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, focus, and human task testing.
knowledge.applicability: Web applications, responsive interfaces, and digital publications.
procedure: Pin the target WCAG version and level
Test screen-reader output and focus order
Review failures with disabled users or qualified experts
knowledge.failure: A single automated score is accepted as proof that the experience is accessible.
knowledge.rights_note: The pinned W3C WCAG version remains authoritative where this secondary guide differs.

knowledge.claim: AX is an operating-model redesign across value, decisions, process, roles, capability, governance, and learning—not merely insertion of an AI feature.
knowledge.applicability: Organization-wide AI transformation and AI-enabled service or product portfolios.
procedure: Assess data, process, people, and governance readiness
Pilot with adoption and risk controls
knowledge.failure: Model deployment, automation count, or training completion is reported as transformation without sustained value or changed operations.
knowledge.rights_note: Broad synthesis candidate; each strategic claim needs primary organizational evidence.

knowledge.claim: Prompt, sketch, or screenshot input should resolve to editable multi-screen structure and inspectable frontend code with explicit interaction links.
knowledge.applicability: AI-assisted wireframing, interface generation, prototyping, and design-to-code workflows.
knowledge.failure: The tool returns a convincing screenshot with no structure, interaction lineage, or maintainable implementation.
knowledge.source_locator: Google Stitch prompt/sketch/screenshot to editable UI and code
knowledge.rights_note: Confirm capabilities and limits against current Google Stitch documentation and an actual export test.

knowledge.claim: Portable agent design context must carry both machine-readable decisions and human-readable rationale, including roles, states, constraints, responsive behavior, and prohibited choices.
knowledge.applicability: Cross-tool design systems consumed by design and coding agents.
procedure: Test the same context across tools
knowledge.failure: A palette and type list is called a design system while intent, state, behavior, and guardrails are absent.
knowledge.rights_note: Bind Atlassian's primary report and license; record token and latency tradeoffs rather than treating portability as free.

knowledge.claim: Reverse-engineering a design system requires computed structure, responsive behavior, interaction states, motion, semantics, accessibility, and cross-page consistency—not color and spacing extraction alone.
knowledge.applicability: Migrating, auditing, learning from, or reproducing an authorized existing web design system.
knowledge.failure: A single screenshot or CSS scrape is generalized into a complete design system and applied without rights or behavioral evidence.
knowledge.rights_note: Extraction does not grant reuse rights; verify the project code, license, robots policy, and target-site authorization.

knowledge.claim: AX metrics must distinguish activity, adoption, operational performance, user outcome, business value, risk, and learning quality.
knowledge.applicability: AI-transformation portfolios, AI-enabled product programs, and organization-level change governance.
procedure: Stop or redesign when outcomes do not improve
knowledge.failure: Automation counts, model calls, or course completion rise while user outcomes, process quality, risk, or business value deteriorate.
knowledge.source_locator: AX KPI, 숫자만 쫓으면 진짜 가치를 놓칩니다
knowledge.rights_note: Practitioner hypothesis; validate metric definitions against the target organization and independent evidence.
